## Overview

::: {.intro}
The 2024 edition of the Geospatial Modelling Workshop — the
programme's first cohort — ran in September 2024 at the University of
Dar es Salaam, covering geostatistics and geospatial modelling with
the INLA approach, the same core curriculum as the 2025 edition.
:::

Geostatistics and geospatial modelling with the INLA approach (same
